paragraphs.text:
You  spin  and  run,  cursing  yourself  for  your  carelessness. 
Norman and Sylvia, waiting a few yards away, do not need to 
be told to follow the leader. The men are more familiar with the 
local terrain, but they have walked far already.

Make a CON roll for the member of your party with the lowest 
CON. If successful, go to 147. If failed, go to 575.
